newsitem.title: CANADA: Taro to sell unit to Precision.
newsitem.headline: Taro to sell unit to Precision.

text.p: Taro Industries Ltd said on Friday it agreed to sell its Rostel Industries unit to Precision Drilling Corp for about C$7.1 million plus working capital.
Rostel, which had revenues of C$8.1 million for the 11 months ended November 30, repairs and certifies oilwell drilling rigs and ancillary equipment.
The unit had earnings before interest, taxes and corporate overhead for the period of C$1.8 million, Taro said.
Taro said it would continue to focus on its core businesses oil production equipment manufacturing and fluids management packaging and distribution.
The closing and effective date for the deal was scheduled for December 31.
